content: Human-labeling session — build-engineer-rebuild-after-loss:hard seed 1. Objective: You hold two bases. Your HOME base sits in the west around x=8, but at a north-or-south latitude (y=14 or y=26) chosen by seed — it has a Construction Yard, a harvester, and a small rifle garrison but NO Power Plant. Your FORWARD base sits on the SAME latitude around x=46 with a Construction Yard, a Power Plant, and a Refinery — and THREE enemy heavy tanks are positioned beside it. Keep at least one Power Plant alive anywhere on the map within about 40 turns. You have $500 in the bank.
